findings.claim: Acceptance 4 uses aggregate child-spawn versus hook-start counts to establish observation coverage. Extra starts from other children can mask an unobserved directly spawned Python child; the mandatory -I/-S/-E tests are not required to include this mixed-child case. The defect remains in the active vung contract after the auxiliary admission tool is retired.
findings.hostile_input: Within one measured phase, launch a healthy Python process through a shell, then directly launch Python with -S (also reproduced with -I and -E) to read a tracked out-of-zone sentinel. The first child contributes a hook start but no counted Python spawn; the second contributes a counted spawn but no hook start. All processes exit zero and the phase prints its positive result.

evidence.observed_output: masked_S, masked_I, masked_E: READ_OK:sentinel; python_children=1, hook_child_starts=1; observed only the in-zone ci.yml witness; reasons=[]; outside=[]; classification=SACH. Control hidden_S without surplus: KHONG_DO_DUOC. Direct, alias and dir_fd controls: NGOAI_VUNG.

suggested_fix.where_and_why: Change Acceptance 4 observation-coverage and self-test requirements together. This is the current vung acceptance rule, not a request to repair or reinstate the retired auxiliary admission script.
suggested_fix.how: Require each relevant Python spawn to be associated with its own observer startup (or fail closed when association is not measurable); unrelated, duplicate or shell-origin starts must not discharge another child’s coverage obligation. Preserve separate phase logs and the declared non-Python boundary.
suggested_fix.locking_test_and_mutant: Add the mixed-child input above for each phase, with -S/-I/-E variants and successful-read evidence; expect KHONG_DO_DUOC. Healthy matched children must remain measurable. A mutant replacing association with aggregate counts must die for the missing child observer.
suggested_fix.regression_risk: PID reuse, fork/exec semantics, failed launches and duplicate hook imports can cause false coverage or false rejection. Do not solve this by rejecting all healthy shell-mediated children or by widening Z.
